name: vision_vae
title: A convolutional VAE: logits decoder, BCE-with-logits reconstruction, analytic KL, gradient-free sampler
origin: domain-vision round 1: the standard VAE shape, whose composite loss (reconstruction + KL) is written as a module-level function

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True
there is no evaluation loader in this project
the loader is built inside build_loader(), reached only from train() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
the only no_grad region is the decorated sample(), which contains no backward()
sample() calls model.eval() before decoding and model.train() afterwards
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
the decoder returns logits and the reconstruction term is binary_cross_entropy_with_logits - the correct pairing; the sampler applies torch.sigmoid itself, once, for the image
the images are moved to the device and the latent draw is allocated with device=
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no split in this project
Encoder, Decoder and VAE all call super().__init__()
every submodule stack is an nn.Sequential
